s2.explanation: The unit responds to a medium-sized, mostly whole furry animal (dogs, wolves, meerkats), especially one with tan or brown fur, seen at mid-distance. It is most active when the head is turned, raised or in profile, as with the howling wolf, the redbone looking up, and the Swiss dog with its head turned. It is weaker on tight face close-ups, straight-on frontal faces, and animals that are small in a cluttered scene or with people. Compared with similar units, it prefers head-raised or profile poses, where the others prefer frontal faces.
